en.title: The Calm Mirror, the Rainy Collector's Shop
en.premise: In a town where the tide roars and retreats, forgotten items hauled in from the sea sometimes take human form. On rainy days, a weathered shop tucked in a harbor corner displays mirrors that reflect memories lost beneath the waves. The young lighthouse keeper one day notices a gaze from a stranger reflected in the glass, hinting at beings slowly approaching the living world as the tide withdraws.

zh.title: 宁静之镜，雨之收集店
zh.premise: 在潮汐汹涌的城镇里，海中带回的遗忘之物有时会化身为人形。雨天时，港口角落里隐匿着一家古旧的店铺，摆满了映照沉没记忆的镜子。灯塔守的青年某日注意到镜中映出一双陌生人的目光，暗示着潮退时，异形们正悄然逼近人间。
